chapter.heading: Praise to God for His Word and Providence
chapter.v:
Praise the
Lord!For it is good to sing praises to our God;For it is pleasant, and praise is beautiful. [Jer. 32:2,]

The Lord
builds up Jerusalem;He gathers together the outcasts of Israel. [Is. 37:26 c Ex. 15:3; [Jer. 10:16]; Amos 5:8; 9:6]

He heals
the brokenheartedAnd binds up their wounds. [Ps. 91:15; [Is. 55:6, 7]; Jer. 29:12 2 inaccessible Jer. 32:24; Ezek. 4:2; 21:22; Hab. 1:10]

He counts
the number of the stars;He calls them all by name. [Is. 22:10; Is. 55:3; Ezek. 16:60; 37:26. In Ezekiel it is equated with a cov-]

Great is
our Lord, and mighty in power;His understanding is infinite. [2 Kin. 23:14; Jer.]

The Lord
lifts up the humble;He casts the wicked down to the ground. [Jer. 30:17; Hos. 6:1]

Sing to
the Lord with thanksgiving;Sing praises on the harp to our God, [Ps. 85:1; Jer. 30:3; 32:44; Amos 9:14 i Is. 1:26; Jer. 28; 42:10; Amos]

Who covers
the heavens with clouds,Who prepares rain for the earth,Who makes grass to grow on the mountains. [Ps. 51:2; Is. 44:22; Jer. 50:20; Ezek. 36:25, 33; Mic. 7:18, 19; Zech. 13:1; [Heb.]

He gives
to the beast its food,And to the young ravens that cry. [Is. 62:7; Jer. 13:11 l Is. 60:5]

He does
not delight in the strength of the horse;He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man. [Jer. 32:43]

The Lord
takes pleasure in those who fear Him,In those who hope in His mercy. [Jer. 7:34; 16:9; 25:10; Rev. 18:23 o 1 Chr. 16:8; 2 Chr. 5:13; Ezra 3:11; Ps. 136:1; Is. 12:4] [Lev. 7:12; Ps. Heb. 13:15]

Praise the
Lord, O Jerusalem!Praise your God, O Zion! [Is. 65:10; [Jer. 31:24; 50:19; Ezek. 34:12-15; Zeph.]

For He
has strengthened the bars of your gates;He has blessed your children within you. [Jer. 17:26; 32:44 s Lev. 27:32; [Luke 15:4]]

He makes
peace in your borders,And fills you with the finest wheat. [Jer. 23:5; 31:27, 31 u Is. 32:1; Jer. 29:10; 32:42; Ezek. 34:23-25; Hag. 2:6-9]

He sends
out His command to the earth;His word runs very swiftly. [Is. 4:2; 11:1; Jer. 23:5; Zech. 3:8; Tsidkenu; cf. Jer.]

He gives
snow like wool;He scatters the frost like ashes;

He casts
out His hail like morsels;Who can stand before His cold? [2 Sam. 7:16; 1 Kin. 2:4; Ps. 89:29; [Luke 1:32]]

He sends
out His word and melts them;He causes His wind to blow, and the waters flow. [Num. 3:5-10; Deut. 18:1; 24:8; Josh. 3:3; Ezek. 44:15 y [Rom. 12:1; 15:16; 1 Pet. 2:5, 9; Rev. 1:6] 4 burn]

He declares
His word to Jacob,His statutes and His judgments to Israel.

He has
not dealt thus with any nation;And as for His judgments, they have not known them.Praise the Lord!
